chains.summary: Explicit textual identification of seven burning torches/lamps of fire (G2985 lampas) with the seven spirits of God (G4151 pneuma).

Two-hop intertextual chain from the Tabernacle golden menorah with seven lamps (Exod 25:31-40) through Zechariah's vision of the golden lampstand, seven lamps, Spirit (4:6), and eyes of the LORD (4:10) to the Lamb's seven eyes / seven spirits of God in Revelation 5:6.

controls.summary: In Revelation 1:20, the seven golden lampstands (G3087 luchnia) are explicitly identified as the seven churches, preventing a false global identity LAMPSTAND = SPIRIT.
